entry.loadErrorDetail: Check your connection and try again.

toast.queued: Saved {title} on this phone. It syncs when you're online.
toast.parked: Couldn't add {title}. It stays on this phone.
toast.undoFailed: Couldn't undo. Try again from Activity.
toast.parkedBackground: {count, plural, one {# entry couldn't be added. It stays on this phone.} other {# entries couldn't be added. They stay on this phone.}}

changes.title: What this changes
changes.emptyExpense: Type an amount and pick a category to see what changes.
changes.emptyIncome: Type an amount and say who paid you to see what changes.
changes.offline: You're offline. This saves on your phone and syncs later.
changes.refused: This can't be saved yet. Check the amount and the currency.
changes.noRate: No rate yet for {currency}. Pick another currency.

sync.title: Couldn't sync
sync.retryFailed: Still can't send it. Try again later.

connect.title: Connect to a server
connect.intro: Use retrospend.app, or the address of a server you host.
connect.invalidUrl: Enter a web address, like retrospend.app.
connect.unreachable: Couldn't reach this server. Check the address and your connection.
connect.notRetrospend: This address isn't a Retrospend server.
connect.appTooOld: This server needs a newer version of the app. Update Retrospend, then try again.
connect.insecureWarning: This server doesn't use HTTPS. Your password and data travel unencrypted. Only continue on a network you trust.
connect.saveFailed: Couldn't save this server. Try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
signIn.codeHint: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app, or a backup code.

error.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
error.invalidCode: That code isn't right. Try again.
error.emailNotVerified: Verify your email first, then sign in.
error.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
error.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.

account.unsynced: {count, plural, one {# change isn't synced yet. Signing out discards it.} other {# changes aren't synced yet. Signing out discards them.}}

activity.title: Activity
activity.unavailable: Activity isn't on this server yet
activity.unavailableDetail: Update the server to see your expenses here.
activity.errorDetail: Check your connection and try again.
